name: LXRXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: A port of the open-source Sonic Potions LXR engine to MPC, with LXR-02-style features written from the manual. Inspired by the Erica Synths LXR-02. The whole panel on one page (artwork by Suns Kiefer), the LXR's voices with PWM and an FX unit, the 64-step sequencer with songs, rolls and the euclidean generator, Force pads and MPC's step sequencer playing the voices in order, voice and step randomizers, a RESET key and the Hrtl LXR-02 DLC presets.
